storyInfo: Hundreds of protestors are imprisoned in Katorga Raion, where they are forced to deal with brutal thugs. Rosalind manages to sneak into Katorga to help Sonya. It was while fighting these thugs that Sonya met Antosha and agreed to work together.

attributes.content: Stop your futile resistance right now!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Your actions this night are unlawful! Admit your wrongdoing!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: We don't want to hurt you! Cooperate—
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Blyat! You hit me!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Filthy beasts! Lunatics!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: All streets surrounding the ballroom are under control. We have the suspects in custody here.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Madness... utter madness.
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Students out of school, Armies out of their regions... is anyone in Ursus where they should be?
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Should we take them in for questioning?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: You can't say you don't recognize their uniforms! How many commoners do you think there could be in those schools?
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: You want to take all these noble sons and daughters back to the station, and wait for the counts and dukes to show up to claim them?
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: So... do we just let them go?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Use your brain, mudak! There might be assassins among them. Who am I supposed to hand over to the council if they come looking, you?
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Gosudar... one more year and I'll be in the Duma and out of this hellhole...
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Why did it have to be now? Damn it all!
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: How much room do we have in the prisons?
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Well, if we clear out everyone who's about to lose their head, we might have room for—
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: ...Think carefully. Can our prisons really take so many?
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Uh... maybe not?
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Of course, of course.
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: But I know the perfect place to hold these lawless lunatics...
attributes.name: Police Superintendent

attributes.content: Gosudar-batyushka... can someone tell me how I come back to this trash heap to find a dozen trucks filled with kids waiting for me?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Oh, the police say they're out of space in the jails and needed to borrow Katorga for these prisoners who were causing trouble at the ball.
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: Never seen the cops so polite! And they left you a letter.
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: 'Honorable'... 'Katorga'... 'useless things'...
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: Give it to me. I'll read it myself.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.text: \nKatorga is already holding plenty of useless things. A few more will hardly make a difference.
\n\nMy regards on behalf of Duke Treplev.

attributes.content: 'Useless things'? That fool of a superintendent has no idea how valuable this opportunity is.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Bring me Gromov. I will be making numerous visits to important people starting tomorrow. He's in charge while I'm away.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Boss got drunk last night, he's not up yet—there must be something in that backstreet bar's drinks!
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: Mudak, how much am I paying you scum to keep the peace?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Dump a bucket of ice water on his head NOW, and tell him to take good care of our guests.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Not one musbeast gets out of Katorga without my say-so.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: You want us to 'take care' of them? You want them alive, or?
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: My dear Khvoin, I know your little brain can't handle complex instructions, so I'm trying to use language that even YOU will understand.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Do NOT engage in your usual habits. Do NOT touch a single hair on these people's heads... you understand who 'these people' are, don't you?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Tch.
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: Do not forget who pays you the money that you waste in those dirty little bars. And don't you dare forget my words.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Their lives have been worth more than yours since the day they were born into their noble names.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.text: My luck had been really good ever since I ran into Antosha's guys.
I got separated from the others in the crowd that night. Maybe I was just too small, but the cops didn't notice me, and I got out of there on my own.
I didn't know if I would ever see Antosha's crew again. Katorga was completely locked down after that night, and there was no way in.
I thought maybe I was meant to be back on the streets...
It didn't take long for me to decide.
I would go look for them.
Energy pipelines can never be completely blocked off, no matter where you are.
I make a good sewer musbeast.

attributes.content: Phew... almost there.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Good... didn't see anyone on the way... don't seem to be any guards around...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Hmm... is there somebody behind me?
Hello?
You scared me!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Who are you? Why are you in the energy pipes—I mean, I'm here too, but you gotta explain!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Oh, I can explain later, but right now, I could really use some help...
I think I might have misjudged the width of this pipeline before I squeezed in.
Could you maybe give me a push?
Fine... not like I can get out if I don't.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You push too. Hrgh—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Phew... thanks.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I didn't think there'd be somebody else sneaking in with me. Are you looking for someone too?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: You too?!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: My friends got arrested a couple of days ago. I heard they might be inside, so I came to check it out.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I'm Rosalind, but my friends call me Leto. What about you?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Ukusik... stupid name that my friends gave me.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Ukusik! That's easy to remember.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Is your friend with the Student Assembly?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Student Assembly? Never heard of it. We've got our own name, the Unbound!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Cool name! But I've never heard it either.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I figure they must be good people, if you're crawling through energy pipes to help them.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: They're... really good people. And my home is here.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: ...Home?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Excuse me! Have you seen any other students around here?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Good heavens, did you just crawl out of the sewers or something?
attributes.name: Calm Noble Student

attributes.content: Well, yeah actually.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Alright, that's close enough. We can talk at this distance. Gosudar...
attributes.name: Calm Noble Student

attributes.content: Wait, you're from the Self-Government Group... I almost mistook you for those Unbound tramps.
attributes.name: Calm Noble Student

attributes.content: Unbound...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Rude, uncouth ruffians... their leader is the worst of the lot. Who does he think he is, acting like he's in charge? What titles do his parents hold?
attributes.name: Calm Noble Student

attributes.content: You saw Antosha? Where are they?!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Just go east from here, and you'll find them behind those filthy factory buildings.
attributes.name: Calm Noble Student

attributes.content: Don't thank me, just... keep moving.
attributes.name: Calm Noble Student

attributes.content: Naum... why don't we go back?
attributes.name: Worried Student

attributes.content: We don't know the situation, and those thugs don't look like they can be reasoned with... besides, I heard there are already students who have gone missing.
attributes.name: Worried Student

attributes.content: Enough, 'Pencil Stub'. You want to hang out with those peasants, you go back on your own. I will not stay and listen to another uncouth word they say.
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: Hey! Why are you talking about them like that?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: What's going on? Who locked you up? What's up with this factory?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We have no idea. The cops grabbed us the night before last outside the ballroom. We're not sure why they took us here.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: No cops in this place, but it's patrolled by some street thugs. I overheard them say that the man in charge is named Pavlovich...
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: I'll remember that. There will be hell to pay when I get out of here.
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: We must be here by some mistake. I don't know how the misunderstanding happened, but I don't plan on accepting his apology so easily.
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: Did you sneak in from outside? Is there a way out?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: You could get out through the energy pipes, but I'm not sure if big guys like you will fit.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Maybe we, er...
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: What? You want to crawl through these pipes that can barely fit a musbeast?
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: I guarantee somebody will be here to pick us up soon.
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: Shh—someone's coming!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I swear I saw something go past!
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: You swear? Hah, mochi perkhoti, just fart next time, at least you'll make a sound!
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: What a waste of time! Even tuskbeasts know to look for a dry slope to dig a hole in on a day like this, and we gotta watch this stupid hole on this ugly wall!
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: You still got booze?
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: Blyat, stop drinking! We only need to watch this hole for another day, then someone will be here to fill it up. You give me that look again, and I'll smash your skull with this bottle!
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: Oh, you wanna see whose skull is harder? Go on, try. You better kill me in one hit, because if you don't, I'm gonna kill you and sell your skin to Gromov for booze.
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: (Seething) Alright, you want a fight, you'll get one! Chort, I love your crazy. Say, you wanna try some wine made from blood?
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: Human blood? You can make wine from human blood?
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: Tuskbeast blood, dura. Whose blood did you think it was, mine? I'm not as crazy as you.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: Say... how far do we have to haul this?
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: Beats me. Hide it where nobody goes. Pavlovich won't let us do this stuff.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: I hate taking orders from that mudak.
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: What can you say, he pays the bills.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: I'm tired. What do these students eat? How did they get so fat?
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: Hey, I've got an idea.
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: There's a hole here, and we've got a thing. We put the thing in the hole—
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: And we'll be free to go drink.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: You're a damned genius!
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: Come, I'll take you to my vodka stash.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: Oh, how sweet. Come, lemme give you a big, warm hug...
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: What are they doing...?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: What's in that sack?
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: They watch from the shadows as the thugs stuff a filled sack into the pipeline.

The sack gets stuck, and the woman irritably pulls it open, revealing black pants and shoes covered in mud and dirt—looking suspiciously like a school uniform. She tries to stuff the leg deeper into the sack.
(Whispers) Shh! Shut up!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I told you, I saw something.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: Sure, sure, smart guy.
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: Pavlovich says we can't kill them.
attributes.name: Male Thug

attributes.content: He was talking about the nobles, mudak... besides, there must be hundreds of them. He wouldn't know if a few went missing.
attributes.name: Female Thug

attributes.content: You... you're going to...
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: No... no...
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: I'll hold them off! Go on without me—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Don't be a hero! Look at their weapons!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Run—!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Did you see how many there were?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: We would have been screwed if we fought them!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Are these the people watching over this turf?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Who are they? Why do they have military-grade weapons, if they're not cops?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: No idea. Here, they're the same as the police... all meanies.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Didn't you say Antosha's guys were here? I didn't see them.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Looks like this one's scared stupid.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Hey, Leto, we gotta find a way to get around this corner. Do you see those two—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Block 7 clear. You can come out and clean now.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Antosha! Found you!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Ukusik?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What are you doing here? I thought you got away that night—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You're alive! Some people said you're dead, some people said you got locked up, I didn't know what to do.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Where's Matvey? Are you alright? Are you listening to me?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: We're fine. We'll be even finer if you raise your voice any louder and draw the attention of those thugs.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Hey! Stop making fun of me!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: We're fine. Matvey, Yura... everyone's here.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Ukusik!
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Uwah...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Well... glad you're alright.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You... you killed people...
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: You're barbarians... murderers...
attributes.name: Naum

attributes.content: Where are you going? Come back!
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Forget him... where did you find this fool?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Picked him up over there.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: This is not a shelter. We don't have time for people like these.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: So we chase them away? Is it okay if those thugs kill them?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Antosha, you need to be careful. You may not care whether he lives or dies, but allowing him to run around may draw unwanted attention.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Antosha! Someone's coming!
attributes.name: Unbound Member

attributes.content: She's armed, and there's blood on her weapon. She looks dangerous.
attributes.name: Unbound Member

attributes.content: Just one? I'll deal with her.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Wait, she's not a threat—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: General!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I thought those bastards had rounded up all the students in the area. Looks like you've protected a good bunch.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Your name's Antosha? I'm Sonya.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You're a student at University of Deity Grypherburg too?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Not exactly... but I'm working with them, for now.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I heard your people surrounded the ballroom that night just to shout a few slogans.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Yeah, it wasn't the best idea.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I don't know Grypherburg so well... what can you tell me about what's going on? What is this place?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: This is Katorga Raion, a former penal industrial plate. It's been derelict for a long time, and even the power supply has been cut.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I heard the city was planning to abandon the place entirely and discard it in the wilderness.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But there are so many people here now, including us...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm guessing it's because of the aristocratic students on your side.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: The police didn't want to have to deal with them, so they sent you here... Katorga is nominally a place for the government to hold criminals, after all.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Alright. I guess it's not that complicated.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The problem is, Katorga is now being run by a bunch of lunatics.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Armed with weapons that no one knows how they got, killing for the sheer fun of it... something seems to be holding them back, for now, but no one knows what will happen if things continue on like this.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Maybe we can work together.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: How many people do you have?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Well... they're not exactly my people, but there are around two hundred students trapped here with me.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Spoiled nobles aren't good for much, no matter how many there are.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I'm in no position to protect you.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: General Zima doesn't need your protection!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: At least we want the same thing, for now. And if you can trust what you just saw me do, you can believe that we'll fight those thugs and get out of here together.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya is silent for a long time, then takes a big step forward, and Antosha follows at almost the same time.
Antosha extends his hand first.
Sonya takes it. They shake hands briefly, then quickly break apart.
Sorry for attacking you.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: It's all good. Fists can talk, and yours told me you're an okay guy. Where did you learn your moves?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Plenty of opportunities on the streets.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Let me make this clear: just because we're working together doesn't make us allies. Our camps will remain separate, but we can spare you some supplies.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Much appreciated. We will do as you say, and make these supplies count. We can discuss joint operations when the time comes.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Deal. See you around, Sonya.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: And take your friends... minus one now, I suppose.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: (Shivers)
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: ...Thank you for protecting them.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Thanks for the help, little Ukusik.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Don't call me that—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Ugh, never mind. You be careful. See ya.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You look terrible, General! Are you alright?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I'm fine... how's everyone? Anybody hurt?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zoya's got a scratch, but nothing serious.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Good.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I didn't think you would come in here on your own... did Istina plan this?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Couldn't wait for a plan. I was afraid it might be too late, so I left a note and came.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Sorry for acting without permission. If you're mad—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: No...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Thank you, Leto.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Hey, not so tight! That's maybe a little too much... Sonya?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Are you...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Are you scared?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Don't be stupid.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It's alright! I'm here now. Put us together, and we can take down anything.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: If two fists won't do it, add two more!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Besides, there are so many people out there, and so many more fists!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Good point, Leto.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I won't be scared anymore.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: 'Sonya.' The name is unfamiliar to us. She was not one of them.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: I know. I won't take it out on her.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: ...I'm just reminded of the professor.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Same here, Antosha.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Do you remember why I was the first person you thought of when you formed the Unbound?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: You were one of the few in the old gang who came from commoner stock. You knew hardship, knew how to produce, and how to survive in Ursus.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Yes, survive. Only through survival can we achieve our ideals. We have to get out of this alive.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: The others need your command now. You must pull yourself together.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Yura, why does Antosha look so terrible?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: That one's wearing a Student Assembly badge. That was our design, from back when we were all in the Petrachevsky Group.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: The Petrachevsky Group? What's that?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: No one told you? Antosha was the first leader of the Petrachevsky Group. After the death of our professor, we were reported by the other students and expelled.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: But others escaped punishment because of their upbringing, and they continue to do stupid, despicable things under the group's old name.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: Especially their leader, Olga! We will never forgive her!
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: This Petrachevsky Group... several dukes had children in it, and a group went to His Imperial Majesty to beg for amnesty.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: Wait a second.
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: Who's this Petrachevsky?
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: Professor of Literature at the University of Deity Grypherburg, and one of those traitors who printed pamphlets slandering the tsar. How could you not know the name?
attributes.name: Whispering Noble B

attributes.content: There are more traitors in the universities than papers they've published! How am I supposed to remember them all?
attributes.name: Whispering Noble A

attributes.content: Order!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: (Whisper) Your Honor, the next two witnesses are of the nobility. They may need more time to prepare...
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: ...Very well.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: While some of this information has already been made public, we will now once again review Sonya's deeds in Katorga Raion...
attributes.name: Arbiter
